title: Build end-to-end Mahin AI platform baseline across backend, web, and mobile
body:
This PR turns the repository from a placeholder into a runnable multi-app implementation for Mahin AI, covering backend services, web client, and Flutter client with real code paths for auth, chat, persistence, and provider integrations. It establishes production-oriented foundations aligned to the required stack (Ollama/Qwen, MongoDB, Redis, Cloudinary, Resend).

- **Backend API (Express + TypeScript)**
  - Added modular API with auth, user, chat, admin, and file routes.
  - Implemented JWT access/refresh flow, role-based authorization, request validation, centralized error handling, and security middleware (Helmet/CORS/rate limiting).
  - Added MongoDB models for users/chats and chat-history persistence.
  - Integrated Ollama text generation (`/api/generate`) using Qwen model config.
  - Integrated Redis caching for chat responses and health/metrics observability endpoints.
  - Integrated Cloudinary upload flow and Resend email service for onboarding/verification messaging.

- **Web app (React + Vite + TypeScript)**
  - Replaced starter UI with authenticated app shell and route protection.
  - Implemented Login/Register, Dashboard (chat history), Chat, Profile/Settings, and Admin pages.
  - Added API client + auth context with token persistence and user bootstrap.

- **Mobile app (Flutter)**
  - Added Flutter app source with API/auth services and persisted token flow.
  - Implemented login and chat screens wired to backend endpoints.

- **Repo/runtime wiring**
  - Added workspace-aware root package config and repo `.gitignore`.
  - Added per-app environment templates and updated README with run/config instructions.

```ts
// backend/src/app.ts
app.use('/api/auth', authRoutes);
app.use('/api/users', userRoutes);
app.use('/api/chat', chatRoutes);
app.use('/api/admin', adminRoutes);
app.use('/api/files', fileRoutes);
```

<!-- START COPILOT CODING AGENT SUFFIX -->



<!-- START COPILOT ORIGINAL PROMPT -->



<details>

<summary>Original prompt</summary>

> Read this carefully before continuing.
> 
> You are not being asked to create plans, ideas, architecture notes, placeholder files, empty folders, documentation-only repositories, mock implementations, or incomplete templates. Your responsibility is to build the actual Mahin AI platform with real, production-ready source code.
> 
> Mahin AI is a real product that we intend to deploy and use. We are building a complete AI chatbot platform available on both web and mobile. The platform will help students, general users, and beginner programmers with learning, knowledge, productivity, and coding assistance. This is not a demo project, not a sample repository, and not a proof of concept.
> 
> Our infrastructure already exists. We have an AWS EC2 server with approximately 30GB RAM and 96GB storage. Ollama is running on localhost:11434. Qwen 2.5 3B is already installed and available. Redis is installed, running, and responding successfully on localhost:6379. MongoDB Atlas will be used as the primary database. Cloudinary will be used for file storage. Resend Email API will be used for email services. The frontend will be deployed on Vercel. The mobile application will be built using Flutter.
> 
> Your task is to implement the complete backend, frontend, and Flutter application using actual source code. Every file must contain real implementation code. Authentication, authorization, chat history, AI chat functionality, Ollama integration, Qwen integration, MongoDB integration, Redis caching, Cloudinary integration, Resend integration, admin dashboard, user dashboard, profile management, settings, logging, monitoring, validation, security middleware, rate limiting, error handling, responsive UI, and production deployment support must all be implemented.
> 
> Do not stop after creating folders. Do not stop after creating templates. Do not stop after creating configuration files. Do not stop after creating documentation. Continue generating actual source code until the application is functional.
> 
> The final result should be a repository that can be downloaded, opened in VS Code, configured through .env files, have dependencies installed, and then run successfully. The goal is that after environment variables are provided and services are deployed, the platform works without requiring major development work.
> 
> Focus on implementation. Build the product. Generate code. Complete the platform.
> 


</details>
